correctness.rationale: The target incidence relation is reconstructed from Cianci--Ottina's P_2^2 description. Exhaustive enumeration gives 853 order-preserving maps; exact pointwise comparability gives components 721 and 132; mod-two boundary ranks are 12 and 23 on 36 edges and 24 triangles, giving one-dimensional H1; exactly the 132-map component is nonzero on H1. A deterministic 708-step sequence of legal beat-point deletions reduces the 721-map component to the 13 constant maps, whose inherited order is P_2^2. Every deletion witness is rechecked in the current induced subposet. The classical two-class comparison follows from the standard fence criterion for finite-space homotopy, McCord's order-complex weak equivalence, and pi_1(RP2)=Z/2.

value.rationale: Finite-space simplicial approximation generally permits barycentric subdivision because a chosen finite model may have too few maps. This exact example answers the natural minimal-source question for loops into a smallest RP2 model: the four-point circle already realizes all classical free-homotopy classes. The 853-map census, H1-exact 721/132 split, and strong deformation retraction of the null component provide structural information rather than an arbitrary table lookup.
